headline: Borneo FC Climbs To Third Place Following Victory Over Manila Digger
seoTitle: Borneo FC Moves Up In ASEAN Club Championship Standings
metaDescription: Borneo FC secured a narrow 1-0 victory over Manila Digger, moving the Indonesian club into third place in the ASEAN Club Championship Group A standings.
aiSummaryBullets: Borneo FC defeated Manila Digger 1-0 in their recent ASEAN Club Championship match.
The victory allowed the Indonesian team to advance to the third spot in the Group A table.
Asgal Habib scored the lone goal that secured the win for his side during the fixture.
aiContextParagraph: The ASEAN Club Championship (ACC) 2026/2027 tournament, often referred to as the Shopee Cup, featured a group stage encounter between Indonesian club Borneo FC and Philippine side Manila Digger. Ahead of the match, reports highlighted the offensive potential of the visitors, who had recorded 19 goals in their previous five outings, prompting a cautious approach from the home team. Following the conclusion of the match, Borneo FC emerged with a 1-0 win, with Asgal Habib credited as the goalscorer. This outcome significantly impacted the Group A standings, pushing Borneo FC into third place. The competition serves as a regional football tournament for professional clubs, with the ongoing group phases determining the trajectory for participants toward the later stages of the 2026/2027 season.
